intendedUse: Normalize a current Isle of Man unit postcode, preserve truthful non-area or no-coordinate semantics, retrieve only a competent rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon corresponding to the unit postcode or a separately labelled outward-code postal context, fit the map and show a translucent surface with source, reference date, classification and confidence.
recordGrain: one live IM unit postcode assignment and its exact source-defined surface or honest non-area/unavailable reason, plus any separately governed outward-code postal context

m2Definition.definition: A current rights-cleared nationwide Isle of Man unit-postcode denominator and an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly corresponding to every searchable geographic unit postcode, or an honest source-defined non-area classification plus a separately labelled real outward-code postal context surface, are pinned by edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions and SHA-256 and published as an approved immutable artifact. Searching a normalized IM postcode through the real AGID API/app must preserve unit versus broader-context grain, fit and render the eligible surface with translucent fill and a clear outline, and show selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date, confidence and any non-area reason. ONSPD PQI 9 placeholders, null geometry, 99.999999 or rounded 100 latitude, longitude 0, post-box/post-office points, addresses, routes, PO boxes, organisations, constituencies, administrative areas, buffers, Voronoi cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2.

officialObservations.finding: The official finder is an interactive Isle of Man address search. Its page expressly limits the service to the user's own personal use. No address search, row extraction or crawl was performed, and the page supplies no postcode Polygon/MultiPolygon.
The current website terms protect site content and do not establish bulk postcode-data, derivative-database, public lookup API or area-geometry redistribution rights.

Page 4 requires the corporate site to use the Post Office's internal RESTful API for Isle of Man-only postcode/address lookup and cap usage against abuse. Page 8 says suppliers may obtain an API overview through the procurement contact. This proves an internal integration exists, not public unauthenticated bulk or redistribution authority; no contact, account, credential, contract or API access was requested.

ONSPD and NSPL are quarterly postcode directories/lookups. They link postcode points to administrative and other geographies using point-in-polygon and assign a straddling postcode to the area containing its mean reference. They are not postcode-boundary products.

ONS postcode products excluding Northern Ireland BT data are reusable under OGL v3 with the stated ONS, Ordnance Survey and Royal Mail attributions. IM falls outside the BT exception. Reuse permission does not supply coordinates or polygon geometry absent from the source.

The guide covers IM codes but states that no geographic coordinates are provided for Isle of Man postcodes. PQI/OSGRDIND 9 means no coordinates/grid reference; eastings and northings are blank for IM. The record specification uses 99.999999 latitude and 0 longitude placeholders for IM and no-grid-reference rows. Those values are sentinels, not a location.

The official catalogue describes the latest online file as ONSPD postcode centroids as at May 2026, covering live and terminated UK postcodes and carrying ONS/OS intellectual-property attribution. The page was updated 24 June 2026 and links OGL v3.
The public ONS item identifies the May 2026 Feature Service and points to ONS licensing. Its description calls the product centroids; it does not assert postcode surfaces.
The latest layer is explicitly point geometry, supports pagination and caps each page at 2,000 records. Even valid points would not satisfy the requested Polygon/MultiPolygon gate.

officialObservations.where: DOTERM IS NULL AND PCDS LIKE 'IM%'
officialObservations.finding: The complete live IM query returned 4,591 distinct format-valid unit codes. Every row has CTRY25CD M83000003, GRIDIND 9, null easting/northing, latitude 100 and longitude 0 in the online service, and no returned geometry. The service has rounded the documented latitude sentinel; it is not a real point.

The public REST root and all six listed folders yielded 25 services, 122 layers and 4 tables with zero metadata errors. No layer/table name contains postcode or postal. The only names matching the broader term post are Post Boxes and Post Offices. This is a dated public-catalog snapshot, not proof that no private or future service can exist.
Post Boxes is a point feature layer. It is a facility layer, not unit-postcode or outward-code area geometry, and it was not queried for features.
Post Offices is a point feature layer. It is a facility layer, not postal-area geometry, and it was not queried for features.

onspdAudit.query: DOTERM IS NULL AND PCDS LIKE 'IM%'
onspdAudit.reproduction: Query the official May 2026 FeatureServer with the pinned where/outFields, returnGeometry=true, orderByFields=OBJECTID and resultRecordCount=2000 at offsets 0, 2000 and 4000. Concatenate features, require 4,591 rows and unique PCDS values, validate ^IM\d[A-Z\d]? \d[A-Z]{2}$, group the outward substring, and count null coordinates, GRIDIND, sentinel LAT/LONG, country code and geometry presence. Do not promote the raw rows or sentinel values.

governmentGisAudit.catalogLimit: Snapshot of the publicly enumerated REST catalog on the observed date; it does not claim that private, unlisted or future services do not exist.

dataQuality.risk: The current reusable ONSPD denominator is internally complete and format-valid for the public query, but every IM row is intentionally coordinate-less and has no geometry. The Post Office Finder is personal-use-only and its API is internal, while the public government GIS catalog exposes postal facilities only as points.

browserReview.reason: No production-eligible real IM Polygon/MultiPolygon exists to serve through the country route. Shared deterministic UI tests verify the fail-closed area capability without presenting ONSPD sentinels, postal-facility points or synthetic cells as IM evidence.

pdfReview.limitation: Poppler rendered the requested PNGs, but the local image inspection tool returned Windows os error 206 even for C:\tmp files. Extracted text, metadata, query totals and file digests were reconciled; no claim of successful visual inspection is made.

visualizationDecision.reason: The authority, rights and geometry audit matrix is clearer than a chart for this binary M2 gate, and no truthful spatial surface exists to map.

blockerSummary: The May 2026 ONSPD public query provides 4,591 distinct live IM unit postcodes under reusable non-BT OGL terms, but every row has PQI 9, null easting/northing, sentinel 100/0 coordinates and no geometry. The official guide confirms that IM postcodes receive no geographic coordinates. The Post Office Finder is personal-use-only and its integration API is internal. The complete public government GIS catalog snapshot contains no postcode/postal boundary and only point layers for post boxes and post offices. No rights-cleared real unit-postcode or outward-code Polygon/MultiPolygon, immutable area artifact or real AGID area path exists.

Obtain an authoritative or rights-cleared real Polygon/MultiPolygon explicitly corresponding to each searchable geographic unit postcode, or an honest unit non-area classification plus a complete separately labelled outward-code postal context release with deterministic unit membership, CRS, topology, validity, terms, attribution, coverage, exceptions and SHA-256. Do not substitute sentinels, facility points, constituencies, administration, buffers, Voronoi cells, parcels or buildings.
Publish an approved immutable artifact without private addresses, personal, customer, building, cadastral or land-right data and preserve exact-unit versus broader postal-context grain.
Pass real IM normalization, loader, API, non-area/unavailable reason, Polygon/MultiPolygon validation, fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
